scope: Exact consumer launch output argv and bounded native crash report attribution; no runtime acceptance claim
findings: Current producer/preflight identities and original 12-element launch are revalidated
Only exact output redirects are added to original launch; helper owns no subprocess or simulator actions
Crash read requires exact native bundle/process/full installed path and native plus filesystem timestamps within actual attempt
Scan and individual file sizes are bounded; symlinks and unstable reads are rejected
Caller must keep original exception authoritative and run capture before cleanup; zero reports is inconclusive
